content: A rolling stone gathers no moss.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Lithos kylindomenos to phykos ou poiei — Publilius Syrus & Classical Lore
explanation: In ancient philosophy, stagnation is the breeding ground of decay: water that ceases to flow turns green with scum; iron that sits immobile rusts into dust. Keep moving, keep learning, keep adapting, and the moss of mental complacency will find no purchase on your stone.
practicalInsight: Shake off mental lethargy today. Read something new, move your body, and take an active initiative.
reflectionPrompt: What area of your life has become stagnant, collecting the moss of complacency and boredom?
